name: Experiment Pleasure
source:
It's a game about two mad doctors trying to create the perfect sex slave. But their competence leaves something to be desired and if the experiment will be a success or a disaster rests on YOUR decisions.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=30&t=6698]Lemma forums[/url]]
translation:
这是一款关于两个疯狂医生试图创造完美性奴隶的游戏。但他们的能力还不够理想，实验成功还是失败取决于你的决定。

[来自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=30&t=6698]Lemma论坛[/url]]
